task.pr_title: Make Wikibase extension compatible with other entity types than Items

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
According to the error message, the failing cast seems to be happening here, and it makes sense because this line is indeed problematic: there is no reason why the `EntityIdValue` we are passed is an `ItemIdValue` in general.

I think this entire method can actually be removed now that you have added other methods for the other classes that we intend to support in this context.
